intro: Rules nobody tells you. Save this, before you need it.

pages.title: At the table
rules: Arrive five minutes early, and leave before the night gets old.
Never check your phone while someone is telling you something that matters.
Learn the waiter's name. People notice how you treat those who can't help you.

pages.title: With people
rules: Return what you borrow in better shape than you got it.
Don't explain yourself to someone who has already decided.
Compliment people on their choices, not their looks.

pages.title: Quietly
rules: Keep your plans to yourself until they're finished.
Never complain about your job to someone who doesn't have one.
If you're not sure whether to say it, don't.

outro: Which one did you learn the hard way? Tell me the number.
